idea: Gasoline Price Spike Triggers Commuter Stress Google Trends

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'gas prices near me' and 'cheap gas' through google_trends adapter

behavior: When retail gasoline prices jump >10% week-over-week, consumer search volume for gas price comparisons and budget fuel options spikes within 3-5 days, signaling discretionary spending compression.

market_impact.rationale: Sharp fuel cost shocks reduce discretionary purchasing power and trigger rotation away from consumer discretionary toward staples.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends 'gas prices near me' search volume rises >40% week-over-week AND gasoline futures are up >8% in the same week
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or if gas price volatility drops below 3% weekly change

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal fuel price volatility and refinery disruptions occur multiple times per year, triggering search spikes consistently.

idea: Freight Rail Car Utilization Collapse Signals Recession Freight Risk

data.source: Association of American Railroads weekly freight car loadings through html_table adapter (public weekly AAR reports)

behavior: Rail car utilization drops >15% week-over-week during demand shocks, preceding broader industrial contraction by 2-3 weeks and signaling logistics stress.

market_impact.rationale: Rail freight is a leading indicator of industrial production and capital goods demand; sharp drops foreshadow equity weakness in industrials.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly AAR rail car loadings fall >12% sequentially AND the 4-week moving average is below the 52-week median
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or when loadings stabilize above prior week level for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Economic cycles and inventory corrections occur multiple times per year; rail data is released weekly and is volatile enough to cross thresholds regularly.

idea: EV Charging Network Expansion Acceleration Signals Green Capex Boom

data.source: OpenChargeMap weekly active EV charger counts (public data, updated daily) through openchargemap adapter

behavior: When weekly new charger installations exceed 3% growth week-over-week for 2+ weeks, it signals acceleration in renewable infrastructure spending and positive capex sentiment.

market_impact.rationale: EV charging buildout requires industrial equipment, materials, and electrical infrastructure; acceleration signals strong green capex demand.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly net new EV charger additions exceed the 12-week rolling average by >25% AND the growth rate is >2.5% week-over-week
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or if weekly growth rate drops below 1% for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger network expansion is continuous; weekly volatility in growth rates crosses thresholds monthly due to funding cycles and deployment timelines.

idea: Unemployment Insurance Claims Volatility Spike Signals Labor Slack Tightening

data.source: FRED Initial Jobless Claims (ICSA) weekly series through fred_series adapter

behavior: When weekly jobless claims drop >15% in a single week after trending elevated, it signals rapid labor market tightening and wage pressure building.

market_impact.rationale: Sharp claims drops foreshadow wage inflation and potential Fed tightening; financial sector reprices rate expectations upward.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly initial claims fall >12% from prior week AND claims level is below the 8-week moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or once claims rise >8% in a single week

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly claims data is noisy and volatile; large single-week moves occur multiple times per year, especially around seasonal adjustments and weather events.

idea: Airport Passenger Traffic Surge From Google Trends Spring Break Bookings

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'cheap flights spring break' and 'hotels spring break' through google_trends adapter

behavior: In February-March, spikes in spring break travel searches lead actual bookings by 1-2 weeks, signaling near-term surge in travel/hospitality demand.

market_impact.rationale: Spring break booking surges drive revenue for airlines, hotels, and restaurants; positive sentiment on discretionary spending.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends 'spring break' related travel searches rise >60% year-over-year in Feb-Mar AND search volume crosses above prior year peak
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or once searches drop below 50-day moving average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Spring break is seasonal and predictable; surges occur annually in Feb-Mar, making this signal reliable within the 30-day window.

idea: Tech Stock Earnings Misses Trigger Volatility Expansion in Semiconductor Holdings

data.source: RSS/news feed counts for 'semiconductor earnings miss' and 'chip stock guidance cut' through rss_count adapter

behavior: When daily RSS news counts for tech/chip earnings misses jump >200% above baseline, implied volatility in semiconductor stocks expands within 1 trading day.

market_impact.rationale: Earnings misses trigger rotation away from growth tech; IV expansion creates hedging demand and volatility premium.

trade_logic.entry: If daily RSS news count for 'earnings miss' + 'chip' OR 'semiconductor' exceeds 3-month rolling average by >150% AND closing IV rank is <70%
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or once IV rank rises above 75%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earnings seasons occur quarterly; off-season earnings surprises happen weekly; daily RSS volatility ensures frequent trigger crossings.

idea: Natural Gas Demand Spike From Cold Weather Google Trends Heating Searches

data.source: Google Trends weekly search volume for 'heating costs' and 'natural gas prices' combined with Open-Meteo daily temperature data through google_trends + weather_series adapters

behavior: When weekly heating-related search volume spikes >50% AND temperature forecasts show sustained cold (<32F for 5+ days), natural gas demand expectations rise sharply.

market_impact.rationale: Cold snaps drive natural gas demand; energy prices respond positively within 1-2 weeks, lifting energy sector equities.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends 'heating costs' search volume rises >45% week-over-week AND 7-day average temperature forecast falls below 35F
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or once weekly search volume drops >30%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Winter weather volatility and cold snaps occur throughout Q4-Q1; search spikes are reliable and predictable monthly.

idea: Restaurant Job Postings Surge Signals Consumer Services Demand Recovery

data.source: HTML table scrape from Indeed job postings (restaurant/hospitality category) weekly snapshot through html_table adapter

behavior: When weekly restaurant/hospitality job postings jump >20% sequentially, it signals rising consumer dining/travel demand and labor market tightness in services.

market_impact.rationale: Hospitality job growth foreshadows consumer discretionary spending strength and pricing power for service businesses.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly restaurant/hospitality job posting count rises >18% week-over-week AND is above the 12-week moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or if weekly postings drop >10%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal hiring cycles, holiday/summer demand swings, and staffing shortages trigger job posting spikes multiple times per year.

idea: Lumber Futures Price Rally Triggers Construction Materials Sentiment Shift

data.source: Price data for Lumber Futures (LBS) daily close through price_only adapter with daily home construction permit data scrape through html_table adapter

behavior: When lumber futures rally >8% in a week AND residential building permit filings rise >15% month-over-month, it signals housing demand acceleration and construction sector optimism.

market_impact.rationale: Lumber spikes + permit growth signals housing boom, driving demand for building materials, equipment, and industrial services.

trade_logic.entry: If lumber futures close >20-day high AND weekly return >6% AND monthly permit filings (lagged 1 week) exceed prior month by >12%
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or if lumber closes below 50-day moving average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Housing cycles and seasonal permit volatility ensure threshold crossings multiple times per year.

idea: Corporate Insider Trading Activity Surge Signals Executive Confidence Shift

data.source: SEC insider trading filings (Form 4) aggregate buy-to-sell ratio weekly through html_table adapter (public SEC Edgar data)

behavior: When weekly insider buy-to-sell ratio (by dollar volume) jumps >1.5x the 8-week moving average, executives are signaling confidence, often preceding 4-6 week rallies.

market_impact.rationale: Insider buying clusters often precede sector rotation; tech insiders' confidence is especially predictive of broad market risk-on sentiment.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly insider buy-to-sell ratio (tech sector) exceeds 8-week moving average by >40% AND exceeds 1.3x baseline
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or if ratio drops below 1.0x for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Executive trading activity is continuous; clustering occurs monthly, especially around earnings seasons and earnings pre-announcement windows.
